nodes.label: Prayer drawer 3D views (garden quilt, yearly yarn, chest, weaves)
nodes.norm_label: prayer drawer 3d views (garden quilt, yearly yarn, chest, weaves)

nodes.label: api() server call (demo shim or Apps Script)
nodes.norm_label: api() server call (demo shim or apps script)

nodes.label: Year reorganisation wizard
nodes.rationale: Paste roster -> match names -> leaders -> preview and schedule; applied automatically on the 1st of the start month.

nodes.label: Prayer note data D (items, people, prays, thanks, weaves, gone)
nodes.norm_label: prayer note data d (items, people, prays, thanks, weaves, gone)

nodes.label: Optimistic concurrency sync via baseRev/stale retry
nodes.norm_label: optimistic concurrency sync via baserev/stale retry

nodes.label: Last-writer-wins merge by up timestamp with gone tombstones
nodes.norm_label: last-writer-wins merge by up timestamp with gone tombstones
nodes.rationale: Every record carries an up timestamp so the later edit wins across devices; deleted items are kept as ids in D.gone so sync never resurrects them.

nodes.label: Prayer cord (weekly knots per person)
nodes.rationale: Knot tied when someone is prayed for this week (Sunday start); adjacent knots tighten the cord; all tied forms bows.

nodes.label: One-card-at-a-time prayer session (ps)
nodes.rationale: Optional opening, per-card timer ring, auto-advance with countdown, auto-scroll, ends with the Lord's Prayer and a thanks line.

nodes.label: Today's three prayer items (least recently prayed first)
nodes.norm_label: today's three prayer items (least recently prayed first)
nodes.rationale: Three items fixed per day so the list does not change during the day; oldest-prayed first keeps all items rotating.

nodes.label: Design style variants (flat/neu/skeu/glass) and accent themes
nodes.norm_label: design style variants (flat/neu/skeu/glass) and accent themes

nodes.label: Share item to community via koide-share handoff
nodes.norm_label: share item to community via koide-share handoff
nodes.rationale: Only text is copied into the community app's write box; publishing scope is chosen there; the note original stays.

nodes.label: Shared display preferences (koide-pref) with community app
nodes.norm_label: shared display preferences (koide-pref) with community app
nodes.rationale: Mode, accent, style and big-text are stored in the same key as index.html so both spaces change together; applied before first paint to avoid flashes.

nodes.label: Autonomous prayer groups (자율 모임)
nodes.rationale: Member-created groups with end date (max 1 year), 12 people, 3 places per person; deleted with all records at end.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI with serialized save queue
nodes.norm_label: optimistic ui with serialized save queue
nodes.rationale: Server (Apps Script) takes 2-4 s, so the UI changes first and saves are chained one by one; the last reply reconciles the month, failures refetch.

nodes.label: Monthly art collection (이달의 그림)
nodes.rationale: Private picture that fills with a hero per prayed day, a prop per newly prayed family, hearts for same-day repeats; never compared with others and never decreases.

nodes.label: No competition / no ranking principle
nodes.rationale: Who prayed how many times is hidden even from leaders; analytics show only aggregates, colour plus numbers, fixed room order.

nodes.label: Add to home screen / PWA
nodes.rationale: Suggest installing once after first contribution on touch devices; service worker sw.js caches files.

nodes.label: Client-side XLSX export
nodes.rationale: Builds an uncompressed (stored) zip of SpreadsheetML in the browser; never includes family-only items.

nodes.label: Anonymous usage logging (design ch.10)
nodes.rationale: Random device id, only actions/numbers, queued locally and sent with start; no names or prayer text.

nodes.label: Prayer cord (기도의 끈)
nodes.rationale: Each family in the small group is a knot slot; praying for neighbouring families tightens the cord and praying for all ties a ribbon. Shows connection without counts or rankings.

nodes.label: Guided prayer session (기도하기)
nodes.rationale: Quiet one-card-at-a-time flow: room families -> my family -> serving staff -> kingdom; per-card timer, auto-advance, hymns.

nodes.label: Shared weave (함께 짜는 그물) 3D picture
nodes.rationale: Group prayer records rendered as threads between anonymous pegs on a hoop with three.js; no numbers shown.

nodes.label: PBKDF2-SHA256 (250k iterations) to AES-GCM-256
nodes.rationale: Passphrase never stored; derived key used only to wrap the real key.

nodes.label: Six recovery words from 2048-word list
nodes.rationale: 65536 divisible by 2048 so masking with &2047 is unbiased; skip-list removes words unsuitable for a prayer note.

nodes.label: Two-layer key encryption (real key wrapped by passphrase and recovery words)
nodes.norm_label: two-layer key encryption (real key wrapped by passphrase and recovery words)
nodes.rationale: A random 32-byte real key encrypts the note; the server stores it wrapped twice (wrap with passphrase key, rwrap with recovery-words key) so a forgotten passphrase can be reset via recovery words without re-encrypting the note.

nodes.label: Demo mode (in-browser Apps Script via gas-shim)
nodes.norm_label: demo mode (in-browser apps script via gas-shim)
nodes.rationale: Without API_URL or with ?demo the server code runs in the browser; demo notes stored separately from real notes.

nodes.label: Department vocabulary (group name, unit, josa)
nodes.rationale: Small-group name (사랑방/순/셀...) and unit (가정/개인) per department change all UI wording and Korean particles.

nodes.label: Kingdom prayer pages (하나님 나라)
nodes.rationale: Daily petition and scripture prayer chosen deterministically by date from topics/seasons; staff can edit texts stored server-side.

nodes.label: Tutorial practice page (?tutorial / ?tutdone)
nodes.rationale: Decision 2026-10-23: tutorial runs on a separate in-memory practice page rather than the real note; practice items are marked and dropped with tombstones; a 6-second fallback returns to the real note to avoid trapping users.

nodes.label: Tutorial practice page (?tutorial)
nodes.rationale: First-time members with no items this month are sent once to a separate practice page; completion recorded server-side (me.tourDone) with device fallback.

nodes.label: Operations admin mode (S.op)
nodes.rationale: Ops/church-wide admins manage departments without a family and the server never sends prayer content.

nodes.label: Demo / tutorial / scene modes
nodes.rationale: ?demo, ?tutorial and scene (?as/&at) run the Apps Script server code inside the browser via demo/gas-shim.js so practice never touches real data.

nodes.label: Meet mode (모임 모드)
nodes.rationale: Full-screen family-by-family view of room-scope items for group meetings, ending with the Lord's Prayer.

nodes.label: Prayer item visibility scopes (room / dept / leader / family)
nodes.norm_label: prayer item visibility scopes (room / dept / leader / family)
nodes.rationale: Each prayer item chooses who may see it; 'family only' items are never exported or shown in meet mode; tapping cycles scope.

nodes.label: Add-to-home-screen prompt
nodes.rationale: iPhone may purge storage of non-home-screen web apps; shared koide-a2hs-off flag so dismissing anywhere stops asking.

nodes.label: Device-local prayer note storage
nodes.rationale: Records stay only on this device (localStorage keyed per Kakao uid) and are never sent to the server unencrypted; per-account keys keep multiple users on one device from seeing each other's notes.

nodes.label: Split by target parsing (label prefix like 엄마ㅡ)
nodes.norm_label: split by target parsing (label prefix like 엄마ᅳ)
nodes.rationale: Same rules as the community app's 'organize by target'; unknown short labels become new people.

nodes.label: openBig()
nodes.rationale: Opens a fresh interactive iframe; actions there are not saved.

nodes.label: pump() (iframe loader)
nodes.rationale: Loads at most 2 iframes at a time, nearest first; keeps placeholder until app's #main/#root renders and .loading/#splash gone, or 6s timeout.

nodes.label: Reset demo data handler (koide-demo-db)
nodes.rationale: Same effect as the app's koideDemo.reset: removes localStorage 'koide-demo-db' and reloads all cells.

nodes.label: SCENES (scene list)
nodes.rationale: Adding a cell requires one line; each scene sets row/col, page (index|note), demo persona (as) and screen (at).

nodes.label: 코이데 화면 지도 (Screen Map)
nodes.rationale: Embeds the live demo app in iframes per cell laid out by flow, so the map follows app changes automatically; standalone (uses no other app files); for planning/ops, excluded from member guide.

nodes.label: start()
nodes.rationale: Waits for resize if window is still 0-width (opened in hidden tab).

nodes.label: Root redirect page (코이데)
nodes.rationale: Redirects to ./app/ preserving query string and hash (e.g. ?join=...) so invite links survive; uses app's background colors incl. dark mode.

nodes.label: Demo personas (김도윤, 한기쁨, 윤하람, 최운영, 박민재, 새사람)
nodes.norm_label: demo personas (김도윤, 한기쁨, 윤하람, 최운영, 박민재, 새사람)

nodes.label: Role-based screens (leader, pastor, dept admin, church admin)
nodes.norm_label: role-based screens (leader, pastor, dept admin, church admin)

nodes.label: Viewport-based lazy iframe loading (MIN_LOAD, MAX_LIVE)
nodes.rationale: Only loads cells that are visible (IntersectionObserver) and not too small (scale >= 0.26), caps live frames at 8, unloading oldest offscreen ones, to avoid overloading.

nodes.label: Move group prayer items into note (groupExport)
nodes.norm_label: move group prayer items into note (groupexport)
